findings.current: He had avenged his friend's enemy and saved his one and only Disciple.
findings.defect: The object of vengeance is reversed: the English says he avenged the enemy rather than avenging his friend by defeating that enemy.
findings.rationale: 친우의 원수를 갚다 means to avenge one's friend, not to avenge the friend's enemy.
findings.replacement: He had avenged his friend and saved his one and only Disciple.
findings.source: 친우의 원수를 갚고 하나뿐인 제자를 살릴 수 있었으니까.

findings.current: If things continued like this, he might have to prepare himself for mutual destruction.
findings.defect: “Mutual destruction” implies that both combatants will be destroyed or killed, while 양패구상 means that both sides suffer serious injury or loss.
findings.rationale: The source describes the risk of both sides being badly hurt, not a definite mutually fatal outcome.
findings.replacement: At this rate, he might have to brace himself for a fight that would leave them both gravely wounded.
findings.source: 이대로라면 양패구상(兩敗俱傷)을 각오해야 할지도 모르는 상황이다.

findings.current: No, it was just when he had begun trying to forget.
findings.defect: The draft adds deliberate intent to forget; the source says he was beginning to lose his memories involuntarily.
findings.rationale: 잊어 가다 describes gradually forgetting, whereas “trying to forget” makes it a conscious act.
findings.replacement: No, it was just as he was beginning to forget.

findings.current: A voice he had heard somewhere before. Yet these were the words of someone he had never heard before.
findings.defect: The second sentence contradicts the first by saying he has never heard the person, rather than that he has never heard that familiar person say these particular words.
findings.rationale: The contrast is between a familiar voice and an unprecedented statement—Taekyung calling him Master—not between familiar and unfamiliar speakers.
findings.replacement: A voice he had heard somewhere before. Yet they were words he had never heard that person say.
findings.source: 어디선가 들어 본 목소리. 그러나 들어 본 적 없는 누군가의 한마디였다.

findings.current: But Jin Taekyung neither heard nor listened.
findings.defect: The draft turns one clause into a deliberate refusal to listen, while the source emphasizes that he did not hear and was unable to hear.
findings.rationale: 듣지 못했다 explicitly marks inability, not unwillingness.
findings.replacement: But Jin Taekyung did not hear him—could not hear him.
findings.source: 그러나 진태경은 듣지 않았고, 듣지 못했다.

findings.current: The next moment, what the Western Heaven Demon Lord saw through his widened eyes was a wrist twisted as though it had been squeezed by a giant, and a young man who had wrapped himself around it like a hook.
findings.defect: The draft says the young man wrapped his entire body around the wrist, distorting the physical action. It is his hooklike grip that clamps around the wrist.
findings.rationale: 갈고리처럼 옭아맨 describes Taekyung's hooked hold on the wrist, not his whole body wrapping around it.
findings.replacement: The next moment, reflected in the Western Heaven Demon Lord's widened eyes were his wrist, twisted as though a giant had wrung it, and a young man whose hand clamped around it like a hook.
findings.source: 다음 순간 서천마군의 부릅뜬 눈동자에 비친 것은, 거인에게 쥐어짜인 것처럼 비틀린 손목과 그것을 갈고리처럼 옭아맨 한 청년이었다.

findings.current: A young brat whose crooked way of speaking and rebellious eyes he had disliked from the very beginning.
findings.defect: The draft omits that the brat was utterly unable to conceal his crooked tone and rebellious gaze, replacing that characterization with the unsupported timing “from the very beginning.”
findings.rationale: 도무지 숨겨지지 않는 characterizes how openly Taekyung's defiance showed; it does not state when Jeok Cheongang began disliking him.
findings.replacement: A young brat whose crooked tone and rebellious gaze were impossible to hide, and whom he had disliked for them.
findings.source: 도무지 숨겨지지 않는 삐딱한 말투와 반항적인 눈빛이 마음에 들지 않았던 어린놈.

findings.current:
But why had that been?

Whenever he looked around, that fellow was always by his side, and he kept catching his eye.
findings.defect: “Kept catching his eye” only means that Taekyung repeatedly attracted his attention; 눈에 밟히다 means that Taekyung lingered in his thoughts and increasingly weighed on his mind.
findings.rationale: The idiom conveys growing emotional concern and leads directly into Jeok Cheongang's heart beginning to change.
findings.replacement:
But why had that been?

Whenever he looked around, that fellow was always by his side, and he could never get him out of his mind.
findings.source: 하지만 어째서였을까. 주위를 둘러볼 때마다 그 녀석이 늘 곁에 있었고 자꾸만 눈에 밟혔다.

findings.current: You seem like a lecherous bastard. You've become even more of a monster since I last saw you.
findings.defect: “Lecherous” adds a sexual meaning absent from the scene. Here 음흉한 describes Taekyung as sly or sneaky for covertly recovering and preparing to strike.
findings.rationale: The remark recognizes Taekyung's concealed readiness and increased power, not sexual behavior.
findings.replacement: You sly bastard. You've become even more of a monster since I last saw you.
findings.source: 음흉한 놈 같으니. 못 본 사이 더 괴물이 되었구나.

findings.current: I don't really know, Old Master. I just… I just can't make my body move.
findings.defect: The draft changes a lack of strength into an inability to move, making Taekyung sound paralyzed rather than physically powerless and dazed.
findings.rationale: 몸에 힘이 안 들어가다 means that he cannot put or summon strength into his body; it does not state that movement itself is impossible.
findings.replacement: I don't really know, Old Master. I just… I just can't summon any strength.
findings.source: 저도 잘 모르겠습니다, 노야. 그냥, 그냥 몸에 힘이 안 들어가요.

findings.current: I could feel the energy curled inside his still-unrecovered body tremble.
findings.defect: The draft uses generic “energy” for Murim 기운 despite the binding distinction requiring qi in this context.
findings.rationale: This is Jeok Cheongang's internal Murim power destabilizing as he tries to draw up his Scorching Yang Qi.
findings.replacement: I could feel the qi lying coiled inside his still-unrecovered body waver.
findings.source: 아직 회복하지 못한 그의 몸속에 웅크린 기운이 흔들리는 것이 느껴졌다.

findings.current: Space was erased, and the natural energy contained within it began to surge.
findings.defect: “Natural energy” fails the binding Murim terminology distinction for 기운 and weakens the immediate force of 요동쳤다.
findings.rationale: The source describes the qi of nature reacting to Taekyung's step; this is Murim qi, not generic energy or Hunter mana.
findings.replacement: Space vanished, and the natural qi within it surged.
findings.source: 공간이 지워지고 그 안에 담긴 자연의 기운이 요동쳤다.

findings.current: The Western Heaven Demon Lord clenched his lips and stretched out a hand.
findings.defect: “Clenched his lips” is not natural English and does not express the physical action of biting his lip.
findings.rationale: 입술을 깨물다 means to bite one's lip.
findings.replacement: The Western Heaven Demon Lord bit down on his lip and stretched out a hand.
findings.source: 입술을 지그시 깨문 서천마군이 손을 뻗었다.

findings.current: “What a long time it has been, you reckless little fool.”
findings.defect: The phrasing is stiff and ceremonial for Jeok Cheongang's affectionate, gruff reunion line.
findings.rationale: 오랜만이구나 is the ordinary spoken “It's been a while,” while 천둥벌거숭이 is a fondly scolding description of a rash, reckless youngster.
findings.replacement: “It's been a while, you reckless little brat.”

summary: One critical semantic reversal and several major errors affecting consequences, characterization, physical actions, and Murim terminology.
